response.sql: WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(l.product_price) AS mean_price, COUNT(l.invoice_number) AS cnt FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items l ON l.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) SELECT AVG(mean_price) AS avg_of_mean_price, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_line_items FROM per_invoice
